message.content: Keysight Technologies Inc sells market-leading design, emulation and test solutions that it connects across the full lifecycle for technology innovators [D1]. Its customers come from AI infrastructure, communications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductor and general electronics, which rely on the company as a mission-critical design enablement partner [D1]. The Communications Solutions Group reported revenue of $1.35 billion in the quarter ended 2026-07-31, up 43.09 percent [D1]. The Electronic Industrial Solutions Group reported revenue of $501 million in the same quarter, up 21.60 percent [D1].
